args.body: The prerequisite evidence for CATALOGUE-COMMISSIONED-REVIEW-OFFER is committed in products/services/catalogue-commissioned-review/brief-decision-evidence.json (TASK-179505900210). Read the actual findings and compare the two briefs. Under a valid lease, use B-02 to show the buyer what judgment the service adds. Verify that both CSV excerpts and the approval brief fit the documented private intake contract before preparing the minimal EN/FR candidate. Use the existing scope fallback if they do not fit. Obtain an exact dry-run digest and hand it to an eligible independent reviewer. No deployment, external send or spending. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.

description: TASK-179505900210 verified a concrete reason to offer commissioned catalogue review. On fictional CSVs, the checker flagged the same price difference for B-02 under both briefs. The saved bilingual report supports an offer revision for independent review. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury is unfunded and reports no verified revenue.
